sql:
SELECT LTRIM(doc_no,'0') AS doc_no, entry_type, COUNT(*)::int AS line_count
    FROM vw_clean_transactions
    WHERE account_no = $1 AND tx_date >= $2::date
    GROUP BY doc_no, entry_type
captureSql:
SELECT md5(t) AS md5, length(t) AS len, t AS rows_json
FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(q)::text, '[]') AS t FROM (
SELECT LTRIM(doc_no,'0') AS doc_no, entry_type, COUNT(*)::int AS line_count
    FROM vw_clean_transactions
    WHERE account_no = 'RED001' AND tx_date >= '2025-05-08'::date
    GROUP BY doc_no, entry_type
) q) x
